hotCodeInspection.scope: On-disk Excel PE bytes at sampled virtual addresses; not a live post-fault RAM read

shortFragmentFinding.policy: Jit::compile rejects IR fragments shorter than three instructions except specific comparisons, counter branches, calls/returns and indirect jumps. The unsupported D3 runtime shift ends this two-SHRD fragment.
shortFragmentFinding.evidenceLimit: Bytes were read from installed Excel PE sections at sampled RVAs; not from live post-fault guest RAM. ModRM operand groups in the runtime profile agree with both source registers.

excludedHostSample.reason: The required named profiler attachment barrier was missing; rejected by the harness. Retry with 10-second barrier passed and excluded 7652 barrier samples.

initialCodeInspector.result: Before-task checkpoint had a nonresident sampled code page, so CPU::read faulted. No performance or code-byte conclusion was drawn from that attempt; its owned private disk was removed.
initialCodeInspector.replacement: Read only the relevant on-disk PE sections through the immutable Office chain; no raw disk or RAM dump.
